items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: Well, Dixieland music, like when this band from New Orleans was out here, this George Lewis band, they play awful strong.

ctx.x: What is your opinion of the difference of the two? Is there much difference in tone? Why do you like the albert? Of course you learned on that, so it's easier for you. But if you had your choice to start on either one of them, which would you pick now?

Well, I noticed that so many clarinet players that I found in the albert and I looked at them, the boar in the albert is much larger than the boar in the bane clarinet. And there's more volume. I can get more volume. I can play just another clarinet player and you can't hardly hear them. Well, Dixieland music, like when this band from New Orleans was out here, this George Lewis band, they play awful strong.
